meta.title: CDC Isolation Precautions — Appendix A
meta.subtitle: Type and Duration of Precautions Recommended for Selected Infections and Conditions
meta.license: U.S. Government work (public domain). N95® is a certification mark of HHS.

records.name: Abscess
records.comments: Until drainage stops or can be contained by dressing.
records.commentsJa: 排膿が止まる、または被覆材で制御できるまで。

records.name: Abscess
records.comments: If dressing covers and contains drainage.
records.commentsJa: 被覆材で排膿を覆い制御できる場合。

records.name: Acquired human immunodeficiency syndrome (HIV)
records.nameJa: 後天性免疫不全症候群（HIV）
records.comments: Postexposure chemoprophylaxis for some blood exposures.
records.commentsJa: 一部の血液曝露では曝露後化学予防を行う。

records.name: Actinomycosis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Adenovirus infection
records.nameJa: アデノウイルス感染症

records.name: Amebiasis
records.comments: Person-to-person transmission is rare. Use care when handling diapered infants and mentally challenged persons.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染はまれ。おむつ使用乳児等の取り扱いに注意。

records.name: Andes virus
records.comments: Patient Placement: AIIR. PPE: Gown, gloves, eye protection, N95® respirator or higher. Duration determined case-by-case with local/state/federal health authorities.
records.commentsJa: 陰圧個室(AIIR)。ガウン・手袋・眼保護・N95以上。期間は保健当局と個別協議。

records.name: Anthrax
records.comments: Infected patients do not generally pose a transmission risk.
records.commentsJa: 通常は感染伝播リスクなし。

records.name: Anthrax
records.comments: Use Contact Precautions if large amount of uncontained drainage. Handwashing with soap and water preferable — alcohol has no sporicidal activity.
records.commentsJa: 大量の制御不能な排膿があれば接触予防。芽胞に無効なため石けんと流水で手洗い。

records.name: Anthrax
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Anthrax
records.nameJa: 炭疽（環境／エアロゾル化芽胞）
records.comments: Wear respirator (N95 or PAPR) and protective clothing; decontaminate persons with powder on them. Handwashing 30-60s with soap and water or 2% chlorhexidine (alcohol inactive against spores). Postexposure prophylaxis 60 days of antimicrobials + vaccine under IND.
records.commentsJa: N95/PAPR＋防護衣。粉末が付着した人を除染。石けん流水30-60秒。曝露後予防60日＋ワクチン。

records.name: Arthropod-borne viral encephalitides and fevers
records.nameJa: 節足動物媒介ウイルス脳炎・熱
records.comments: Includes eastern/western/Venezuelan equine encephalomyelitis, St Louis, California encephalitis, West Nile; dengue, Oropouche, yellow fever, Colorado tick fever. Install screens; use DEET repellents and cover extremities.
records.commentsJa: 各種ウイルス脳炎・熱。窓戸に網戸、DEET忌避剤、露出防止。

records.name: Ascariasis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Aspergillosis
records.comments: Contact Precautions and Airborne if massive soft tissue infection with copious drainage and repeated irrigations required.
records.commentsJa: 大量排膿を伴う広範な軟部組織感染で反復洗浄が必要なら接触＋空気予防。

records.name: Babesiosis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person, except rarely by transfusion.
records.commentsJa: 輸血によるまれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Blastomycosis, North American
records.nameJa: ブラストミセス症（北米）
records.comments: Cutaneous or pulmonary. Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: 皮膚・肺。ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Botulism
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Bronchiolitis
records.comments: See Respiratory Infections in infants and young children. Use mask according to Standard Precautions.
records.commentsJa: 乳幼児の呼吸器感染参照。標準予防に従いマスク。

records.name: Brucellosis
records.nameJa: ブルセラ症（波状熱・マルタ熱）
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person, except rarely via banked spermatozoa and sexual contact. Provide antimicrobial prophylaxis following laboratory exposure.
records.commentsJa: まれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。検査室曝露では抗菌薬予防。

records.name: Campylobacter gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: カンピロバクター腸炎

records.name: Candidiasis
records.comments: All forms including mucocutaneous.
records.commentsJa: 粘膜皮膚型を含む全型。

records.name: Cat-scratch fever
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Chancroid
records.comments: Transmitted sexually from person to person.
records.commentsJa: 性行為感染。

records.name: Chlamydia trachomatis
records.nameJa: クラミジア性器感染（鼠径リンパ肉芽腫）

records.name: Chlamydia trachomatis
records.nameJa: クラミジア肺炎（生後3か月以下）

records.name: Chlamydia pneumoniae
records.comments: Outbreaks in institutionalized populations reported, rarely.
records.commentsJa: 施設集団でのアウトブレイク報告あり（まれ）。

records.name: Closed-cavity infection
records.nameJa: 閉鎖腔感染（開放ドレーン・軽度）
records.comments: Contact Precautions if there is copious uncontained drainage.
records.commentsJa: 大量で制御不能な排膿があれば接触予防。

records.name: Closed-cavity infection
records.nameJa: 閉鎖腔感染（ドレーンなし・閉鎖式）

records.name: Clostridium botulinum
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Clostridium difficile
records.nameJa: クロストリジオイデス・ディフィシル
records.comments: See Gastroenteritis, C. difficile. Handwashing with soap and water; do not share electronic thermometers; hypochlorite for environmental cleaning if transmission continues.
records.commentsJa: アルコール無効のため石けんと流水。電子体温計の共用禁止。伝播継続時は次亜塩素酸で環境清掃。

records.name: Clostridium perfringens
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Clostridium perfringens
records.nameJa: ウェルシュ菌ガス壊疽
records.comments: Person-to-person transmission rare. Use Contact Precautions if wound drainage is extensive.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染はまれ。創部排膿が広範なら接触予防。

records.name: Coccidioidomycosis
records.nameJa: コクシジオイデス症（排膿病変）
records.comments: Not transmitted person to person except under extraordinary circumstances.
records.commentsJa: 例外的状況を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Coccidioidomycosis
records.nameJa: コクシジオイデス症（肺炎）
records.comments: Not transmitted person to person except under extraordinary circumstances.
records.commentsJa: 例外的状況を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Colorado tick fever
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Congenital rubella
records.comments: Standard Precautions if nasopharyngeal and urine cultures repeatedly negative after 3 mos. of age.
records.commentsJa: 生後3か月以降に咽頭・尿培養が反復陰性なら標準予防。

records.name: Conjunctivitis
records.nameJa: 急性ウイルス性（急性出血性）結膜炎
records.comments: Adenovirus most common; enterovirus 70, Coxsackie A24 also. Highly contagious; outbreaks in eye clinics and neonatal settings reported.
records.commentsJa: アデノが最多。極めて伝染性が高く眼科・新生児施設で流行報告。

records.name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
records.nameJa: クロイツフェルト・ヤコブ病
records.comments: CJD, vCJD. Use disposable instruments or special sterilization/disinfection for surfaces contaminated with neural tissue. No special burial procedures.
records.commentsJa: 神経組織汚染には使い捨て器具か特別滅菌。特別な埋葬手順は不要。

records.name: Cryptococcosis
records.comments: Not transmitted person to person except rarely via tissue and corneal transplant.
records.commentsJa: 組織・角膜移植によるまれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Cryptosporidiosis
records.nameJa: クリプトスポリジウム症

records.name: Cysticercosis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Cytomegalovirus infection
records.nameJa: サイトメガロウイルス感染症
records.comments: Including neonates and immunosuppressed. No additional precautions for pregnant HCWs.
records.commentsJa: 新生児・免疫抑制者を含む。妊娠中の医療者に追加予防は不要。

records.name: Dengue fever
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Diphtheria
records.durationJa: 抗菌薬終了かつ培養陰性まで
records.comments: Until 2 cultures taken 24 hours apart negative.
records.commentsJa: 24時間あけた2回の培養が陰性になるまで。

records.name: Diphtheria
records.durationJa: 抗菌薬終了かつ培養陰性まで
records.comments: Until 2 cultures taken 24 hours apart negative.
records.commentsJa: 24時間あけた2回の培養が陰性になるまで。

records.name: Echinococcosis
records.nameJa: エキノコックス症（包虫症）
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Enteroviral infections
records.nameJa: エンテロウイルス感染症
records.comments: Group A/B Coxsackie and Echoviruses (excludes polio). Use Contact Precautions for diapered or incontinent children for duration of illness and to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ使用・失禁の小児では罹病期間中および流行制御に接触予防。

records.name: Epiglottitis (Haemophilus influenzae type b)
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで
records.comments: See specific disease agents for epiglottitis due to other etiologies.

records.name: Epstein-Barr virus infection
records.nameJa: EBウイルス感染症（伝染性単核症）
records.comments: Including infectious mononucleosis.

records.name: Food poisoning
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Food poisoning
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Food poisoning
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Furunculosis, staphylococcal
records.nameJa: ブドウ球菌性癤（せつ）症
records.comments: Contact if drainage not controlled. Follow institutional policies if MRSA.
records.commentsJa: 排膿が制御できなければ接触予防。MRSAは施設方針に従う。

records.name: Furunculosis, staphylococcal
records.nameJa: ブドウ球菌性癤症（乳幼児）
records.comments: With wound lesions, until wounds stop draining.
records.commentsJa: 創病変がある場合、排膿が止まるまで。

records.name: Gangrene (gas gangrene)
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Use Contact Precautions for diapered or incontinent persons for the duration of illness or to control institutional outbreaks (applies to the agents below).
records.commentsJa: おむつ使用・失禁者では罹病期間中および流行制御に接触予防（下記各病原体に適用）。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（アデノウイルス）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（カンピロバクター）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Discontinue antibiotics if appropriate. Do not share electronic thermometers; ensure environmental cleaning; hypochlorite may be required if transmission continues. Handwashing with soap and water preferred (alcohol not sporicidal).
records.commentsJa: 可能なら抗菌薬中止。電子体温計を共用しない。環境清掃徹底、伝播継続時は次亜塩素酸。石けんと流水で手洗い（アルコールは芽胞に無効）。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（クリプトスポリジウム）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.sub: E. coli O157:H7 and Shiga toxin-producing
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（腸管出血性大腸菌O157等）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（その他の大腸菌）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for a minimum of 48 hours after resolution of symptoms or to control outbreaks. Masks for those cleaning heavily contaminated areas (virus can aerosolize). Hypochlorite may be required; alcohol less active. Type of Precaution updated Standard → Contact + Standard.
records.commentsJa: 症状消失後最低48時間は接触予防。糞便・吐物はエアロゾル化しうるためマスク。次亜塩素酸推奨、アルコールは効果が弱い。2019年に標準→接触＋標準へ改訂。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Ensure environmental cleaning and frequent removal of soiled diapers. Prolonged shedding may occur in both immunocompetent and immunocompromised children and the elderly.
records.commentsJa: 環境清掃と汚染おむつの頻回交換。小児・高齢者では排出が遷延しうる。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（サルモネラ／腸チフス）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.nameJa: 胃腸炎（ウイルス性・他項目外）
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Gastroenteritis
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent persons for duration of illness or to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者では罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Guillain-Barré syndrome
records.nameJa: ギラン・バレー症候群
records.comments: Not an infectious condition.
records.commentsJa: 感染症ではない。

records.name: Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome
records.nameJa: ハンタウイルス肺症候群
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Helicobacter pylori
records.nameJa: ヘリコバクター・ピロリ

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.comments: Provide hepatitis A vaccine postexposure as recommended.
records.commentsJa: 推奨に従い曝露後にA型肝炎ワクチン。

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.nameJa: ウイルス性肝炎（A型・おむつ／失禁）
records.comments: Contact Precautions: infants/children <3y for duration of hospitalization; 3-14y for 2 weeks after onset; >14y for 1 week after onset.
records.commentsJa: 3歳未満は入院中、3-14歳は発症後2週、14歳超は発症後1週。

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.nameJa: ウイルス性肝炎（B型・HBsAg陽性）
records.comments: Acute or chronic. See specific recommendations for hemodialysis centers.
records.commentsJa: 急性・慢性。血液透析施設は個別推奨参照。

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.nameJa: ウイルス性肝炎（C型ほか）
records.comments: See specific recommendations for hemodialysis centers.
records.commentsJa: 血液透析施設は個別推奨参照。

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.comments: Seen only with hepatitis B.
records.commentsJa: B型肝炎に併発する場合のみ。

records.name: Hepatitis, viral
records.comments: Contact Precautions for diapered/incontinent individuals for duration of illness.
records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁者は罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Herpes simplex
records.nameJa: 単純ヘルペス（粘膜皮膚・播種／重症初発）
records.durationJa: 病変が乾燥・被殻化するまで

records.name: Herpes simplex
records.nameJa: 単純ヘルペス（粘膜皮膚・再発）
records.comments: Skin, oral, genital.

records.name: Herpes simplex
records.durationJa: 病変が乾燥・被殻化するまで
records.comments: Also for asymptomatic exposed infants delivered vaginally/C-section if mother has active infection and membranes ruptured >4-6h, until surface cultures at 24-36h are negative after 48h incubation.

records.name: Herpes zoster (shingles)
records.nameJa: 帯状疱疹（播種性／免疫不全の局所）
records.comments: Susceptible HCWs should not enter room if immune caregivers available; localized disease in immunocompromised until disseminated infection ruled out.
records.commentsJa: 免疫のある医療者がいれば感受性者は入室しない。免疫不全の局所例は播種を除外するまで。

records.name: Herpes zoster (shingles)
records.nameJa: 帯状疱疹（局所・免疫正常）
records.durationJa: 病変が乾燥・被殻化するまで
records.comments: Susceptible HCWs should not provide direct care when other immune caregivers are available; lesions can be contained/covered.
records.commentsJa: 病変を覆える場合。感受性の医療者は免疫のある者がいれば直接ケアを避ける。

records.name: Histoplasmosis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
records.nameJa: ヒト免疫不全ウイルス（HIV）
records.comments: Postexposure chemoprophylaxis for some blood exposures.
records.commentsJa: 一部の血液曝露で曝露後化学予防。

records.name: Human metapneumovirus
records.nameJa: ヒトメタニューモウイルス
records.comments: Assumed Contact transmission as for RSV. Wear masks per Standard Precautions.
records.commentsJa: RSV同様に接触感染と想定。標準予防に従いマスク。

records.name: Impetigo
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで

records.name: Influenza
records.nameJa: インフルエンザ（季節性）
records.comments: See current CDC Prevention Strategies for Seasonal Influenza in Healthcare Settings.
records.commentsJa: 最新のCDC季節性インフルエンザ院内対策を参照。

records.name: Influenza
records.nameJa: インフルエンザ（鳥・H5N1等）
records.comments: See current CDC interim guidance for novel influenza A viruses associated with severe disease.
records.commentsJa: 重症化する新型インフルA暫定指針を参照。

records.name: Influenza
records.nameJa: インフルエンザ（パンデミック）
records.comments: Also a human influenza virus. See current CDC interim guidance.
records.commentsJa: 最新のCDC暫定指針を参照。

records.name: Kawasaki syndrome
records.comments: Not an infectious condition.
records.commentsJa: 感染症ではない。

records.name: Legionnaires’ disease
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Leptospirosis
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Lice
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで

records.name: Lice
records.comments: Transmitted person-to-person through infested clothing. Wear gown and gloves when removing clothing.
records.commentsJa: 汚染衣類を介して感染。脱衣時はガウン・手袋。

records.name: Lice
records.comments: Transmitted through sexual contact.
records.commentsJa: 性的接触で感染。

records.name: Listeriosis
records.comments: Person-to-person transmission rare; cross-transmission in neonatal settings reported.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染はまれ。新生児施設での交差感染報告あり。

records.name: Lyme disease
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Lymphocytic choriomeningitis
records.nameJa: リンパ球性脈絡髄膜炎
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Malaria
records.comments: Not transmitted person to person except through transfusion rarely and failure to follow Standard Precautions. Install screens; use DEET repellents.
records.commentsJa: 輸血等のまれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。網戸・DEET忌避剤。

records.name: Measles (rubeola)
records.duration: 4 days after onset of rash (duration of illness if immunocompromised)
records.durationJa: 発疹出現後4日（免疫抑制者は罹病期間）
records.comments: Susceptible HCP should not enter room if immune providers available; regardless of presumptive immunity, HCP should use at least a fit-tested N95 respirator on entry. Postexposure vaccine within 72h or immune globulin within 6 days. Place exposed susceptibles on Airborne Precautions.
records.commentsJa: 免疫のある医療者がいれば感受性者は入室しない。免疫の推定有無に関わらず入室時にN95以上を着用。曝露後72時間以内にワクチン、6日以内に免疫グロブリン。

records.name: Melioidosis
records.nameJa: 類鼻疽（メリオイドーシス）
records.comments: All forms. Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: 全型。ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Meningitis
records.nameJa: 髄膜炎（無菌性・ウイルス性）
records.comments: Contact for infants and young children. See Enteroviral infections.
records.commentsJa: 乳幼児は接触予防。

records.name: Meningitis
records.nameJa: 髄膜炎（グラム陰性腸内細菌・新生児）

records.name: Meningitis
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで

records.name: Meningitis
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで
records.comments: See Meningococcal Disease.

records.name: Meningitis
records.comments: Concurrent active pulmonary disease or draining lesions may necessitate Contact and/or Airborne. For children, Airborne until active TB ruled out in visiting family.
records.commentsJa: 活動性肺結核や排膿病変の併発時は接触・空気予防を追加。小児は面会家族の活動性結核を除外するまで空気予防。

records.name: Meningococcal disease
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで
records.comments: Sepsis, pneumonia, meningitis. Postexposure chemoprophylaxis for household contacts and HCWs exposed to respiratory secretions; postexposure vaccine only to control outbreaks.
records.commentsJa: 敗血症・肺炎・髄膜炎。同居者や気道分泌物に曝露した医療者へ曝露後化学予防。

records.name: Monkeypox
records.comments: See CDC Monkeypox website for infection prevention and control.
records.commentsJa: CDCのMpoxサイトを参照。

records.name: Multidrug-resistant organisms (MDROs)
records.comments: MRSA, VRE, VISA/VRSA, ESBLs, resistant S. pneumoniae. Contact Precautions in settings with ongoing transmission, increased risk, or wounds not contained by dressings. Contact state health department for new/emerging MDRO.
records.commentsJa: 伝播継続・高リスク環境・被覆材で覆えない創部では接触予防。新規MDROは保健当局に相談。

records.name: Mumps (infectious parotitis)
records.nameJa: 流行性耳下腺炎（おたふくかぜ）
records.duration: Until 5 days after onset of swelling
records.comments: Isolation changed from 9 days to 5 days after onset of parotid swelling (HICPAC, 2017). Susceptible HCWs should not provide care if immune caregivers available.
records.commentsJa: 隔離は腫脹発症後9日→5日に変更（2017年）。免疫のある医療者がいれば感受性者はケアしない。

records.name: Mycobacteria, nontuberculosis (atypical)
records.comments: Pulmonary and wound forms Standard. Not transmitted person-to-person.
records.commentsJa: 肺・創ともに標準予防。ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Necrotizing enterocolitis
records.comments: Contact Precautions when cases clustered temporally.
records.commentsJa: 時間的に集積する場合は接触予防。

records.name: Nipah virus
records.comments: Patient Placement: AIIR. If suspect and clinically stable: gown, gloves, eye protection, N95® or higher. If suspect and unstable OR confirmed: use PPE per VHF guidance. Duration case-by-case with health authorities.
records.commentsJa: 陰圧個室(AIIR)。疑い＋安定：ガウン・手袋・眼保護・N95以上。疑い＋不安定または確定：VHFに準じたPPE。

records.name: Nocardiosis
records.comments: Draining lesions or other presentations. Not transmitted person-to-person.
records.commentsJa: 排膿病変その他。ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Orf
records.nameJa: オルフ（伝染性膿疱性皮膚炎）

records.name: Parainfluenza virus infection
records.nameJa: パラインフルエンザ感染症
records.comments: Respiratory in infants and young children. Viral shedding may be prolonged in immunosuppressed patients; reliability of antigen testing to guide removal from Contact Precautions uncertain.
records.commentsJa: 免疫抑制者では排出が遷延しうる。抗原検査での解除判断は信頼性不確実。

records.name: Parvovirus B19
records.nameJa: パルボウイルスB19（リンゴ病）
records.comments: Maintain precautions for duration of hospitalization when chronic disease occurs in immunocompromised. For transient aplastic/red-cell crisis, maintain 7 days.
records.commentsJa: 免疫不全の慢性例は入院中維持。一過性赤芽球癆・無形成発作は7日間維持。

records.name: Pediculosis (lice)
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで

records.name: Pertussis (whooping cough)
records.durationJa: 有効な抗菌薬開始後5日まで
records.comments: Single patient room preferred; cohorting an option. Postexposure chemoprophylaxis for household contacts and HCWs with prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions.
records.commentsJa: 個室が望ましい。同居者や長時間気道分泌物に曝露した医療者へ曝露後化学予防。

records.name: Plague (Yersinia pestis)
records.durationJa: 有効な抗菌薬開始後48時間まで
records.comments: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for exposed HCW.
records.commentsJa: 曝露した医療者に抗菌薬予防。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.comments: Outbreaks in pediatric and institutional settings reported. In immunocompromised hosts, extend Droplet and Contact due to prolonged shedding.
records.commentsJa: 免疫不全者では排出遷延のため飛沫・接触予防を延長。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.nameJa: 肺炎（他項目外の細菌性）
records.comments: Including gram-negative bacterial.

records.name: Pneumonia
records.nameJa: 肺炎（B. cepacia・嚢胞性線維症）
records.comments: Avoid exposure to other persons with CF; private room preferred. Criteria for discontinuation not established.
records.commentsJa: 他のCF患者との接触を避ける。個室が望ましい。解除基準は未確立。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで

records.name: Pneumonia

records.comments: See Meningococcal Disease.

records.name: Pneumonia
records.nameJa: 肺炎（マイコプラズマ・原発性異型）

records.name: Pneumonia
records.comments: Use Droplet Precautions if evidence of transmission within a unit or facility.
records.commentsJa: 施設内伝播の証拠があれば飛沫予防。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.nameJa: 肺炎（ニューモシスチス）
records.comments: Avoid placement in the same room with an immunocompromised patient.
records.commentsJa: 免疫不全患者と同室にしない。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.comments: For MRSA, see MDROs.
records.commentsJa: MRSAはMDRO参照。

records.name: Pneumonia
records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで
records.comments: Contact Precautions if skin lesions present.
records.commentsJa: 皮膚病変があれば接触予防。

records.name: Pneumonia

records.durationJa: 有効治療開始後24時間まで
records.comments: Contact Precautions if skin lesions present.

records.nameJa: 肺炎（ウイルス性・成人）

records.commentsJa: 排膿が止まる／被覆材で制御できるまで。

records.name: Pressure ulcer
records.comments: If dressing covers and contains drainage.
records.commentsJa: 被覆材で排膿を覆い制御できる場合。

records.name: Psittacosis (ornithosis)
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Rabies
records.comments: Person-to-person transmission rare; via corneal/tissue/organ transplants reported. If bitten or saliva contaminates a wound/mucous membrane, wash thoroughly and give postexposure prophylaxis.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染はまれ。咬傷・唾液曝露時は洗浄し曝露後予防。

records.name: Rat-bite fever
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Relapsing fever
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.

records.comments: Also see syndromes/conditions in Table 2.
records.commentsJa: Table 2の症候群も参照。

records.name: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)
records.comments: Infants, young children and immunocompromised adults. Wear mask per Standard Precautions. In immunocompromised, extend Contact due to prolonged shedding; reliability of antigen testing to guide removal uncertain.
records.commentsJa: 免疫不全者は排出遷延のため接触予防を延長。抗原検査での解除判断は信頼性不確実。

records.name: Reye’s syndrome
records.comments: Not an infectious condition.
records.commentsJa: 感染症ではない。

records.name: Rheumatic fever
records.comments: Not an infectious condition.
records.commentsJa: 感染症ではない。

records.name: Rhinovirus
records.comments: Droplet most important route. Add Contact Precautions if copious moist secretions and close contact likely (e.g., young infants).
records.commentsJa: 飛沫が主経路。分泌物が多く濃厚接触が想定されれば接触予防を追加。

records.name: Rickettsial fevers, tickborne
records.nameJa: リケッチア熱（ダニ媒介）
records.comments: Rocky Mountain spotted fever, tickborne typhus. Not transmitted person to person except through transfusion, rarely.
records.commentsJa: 輸血によるまれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Rickettsialpox
records.comments: Not transmitted from person to person.
records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染しない。

records.name: Ringworm (dermatophytosis)
records.comments: Rarely, outbreaks in healthcare settings. Use Contact Precautions for outbreak.
records.commentsJa: まれに院内流行。流行時は接触予防。

records.name: Rocky Mountain spotted fever
records.comments: Not transmitted person to person except through transfusion, rarely.
records.commentsJa: 輸血によるまれな例外を除きヒト-ヒト感染しない。

aliases: とっぱつせいほっしん
records.comments: Exanthem subitum; caused by HHV-6.

records.name: Rubella (German measles)
records.duration: Until 7 days after onset of rash
records.comments: Susceptible HCWs should not enter room if immune caregivers available. Non-immune pregnant women should not care for these patients. Vaccine within 3 days of exposure.
records.commentsJa: 免疫のある医療者がいれば感受性者は入室しない。非免疫の妊婦はケアしない。曝露後3日以内にワクチン。

records.comments: See Staphylococcal Disease, scalded skin syndrome.

records.name: Severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS)
records.nameJa: 重症急性呼吸器症候群（SARS）
records.duration: Duration of illness + 10 days after fever resolves
records.durationJa: 罹病期間＋解熱後10日（呼吸器症状の消失・改善まで）
records.comments: Airborne preferred; Droplet if AIIR unavailable. N95 or higher; eye protection. Aerosol-generating procedures and "supershedders" highest risk. Vigilant environmental disinfection.
records.commentsJa: 空気予防が望ましい（AIIRなければ飛沫）。N95以上＋眼保護。エアロゾル発生手技と大量排出者が最高リスク。環境消毒を徹底。

records.name: Smallpox (variola)
records.comments: Until all scabs have crusted and separated (3-4 weeks). Non-vaccinated HCWs should not provide care when immune HCWs available; N95 or higher; postexposure vaccine within 4 days protective.
records.commentsJa: 全ての痂皮が形成・脱落するまで（3-4週）。免疫HCWがいれば未接種者はケアしない。N95以上。曝露後4日以内のワクチンが有効。

records.name: Staphylococcal disease (S. aureus)
records.nameJa: 黄色ブドウ球菌感染症（皮膚・創・熱傷／大）

records.name: Staphylococcal disease (S. aureus)
records.nameJa: 黄色ブドウ球菌感染症（皮膚・創・熱傷／軽微）

records.name: Staphylococcal disease (S. aureus)
records.nameJa: 黄色ブドウ球菌感染症（腸炎）

records.commentsJa: おむつ・失禁の小児は罹病期間中に接触予防。

records.name: Staphylococcal disease (S. aureus)

records.commentsJa: 重症侵襲性のアウトブレイク報告。排膿創は接触予防、抗菌薬予防に従う。

records.name: Toxoplasmosis

records.commentsJa: ヒト-ヒト感染はまれ（母子・移植・輸血）。

records.name: Toxic shock syndrome
records.nameJa: 毒素性ショック症候群（TSS）
records.comments: Droplet Precautions for first 24h of antibiotic therapy if Group A Streptococcus is a likely etiology.
records.commentsJa: A群溶連菌が疑われる場合は抗菌薬開始後24時間飛沫予防。

records.name: Tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis)

records.comments: Discontinue precautions only when improving clinically and drainage ceased or 3 consecutive negative cultures. Examine for active pulmonary TB.
records.commentsJa: 臨床改善し排膿停止、または連続3回培養陰性まで解除しない。活動性肺結核を検索。

records.name: Tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis)
records.nameJa: 結核（肺外・排膿なし／髄膜炎）
records.comments: Examine for evidence of pulmonary TB. For infants/children, use Airborne until active pulmonary TB in visiting family ruled out.
records.commentsJa: 肺結核の有無を検索。小児は面会家族の活動性肺結核を除外するまで空気予防。

records.name: Tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis)
records.durationJa: 有効治療・臨床改善・塗抹3回陰性まで
records.comments: Discontinue only when on effective therapy, improving clinically, and 3 consecutive sputum smears negative for AFB collected on separate days.
records.commentsJa: 有効治療下で臨床改善し、別日に採取した喀痰塗抹が連続3回抗酸菌陰性になるまで。

records.name: Tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis)
records.durationJa: 感染性が無視できると判断されるまで
records.comments: Discontinue only when infectious TB deemed negligible and either another diagnosis explains the syndrome or 3 sputum smears for AFB are negative (each 8-24h apart, ≥1 early morning).
records.commentsJa: 感染性TBが無視できると判断され、別診断が説明可能か塗抹3回陰性になるまで解除しない。

records.name: Typhus

records.name: Vaccinia
records.comments: Vaccination site care: semi-permeable dressing over gauze until scab separates (~3-5 days); gloves and hand hygiene for dressing change.
records.commentsJa: 接種部位ケア：痂皮脱落まで半透過性被覆（約3-5日）。被覆交換時は手袋・手指衛生。

records.name: Vaccinia (adverse events)
records.nameJa: ワクシニア有害事象（湿疹性・胎児・全身性・進行性）
records.duration: Until lesions dry and crusted, scabs separated
records.durationJa: 病変が乾燥・被殻化し痂皮が脱落するまで
records.comments: For contact with virus-containing lesions and exudative material.
records.commentsJa: ウイルス含有病変・滲出物との接触に対して。

records.name: Vaccinia (adverse events)
records.nameJa: ワクシニア有害事象（眼瞼炎・結膜炎）
records.comments: Use Contact Precautions if there is copious drainage.
records.commentsJa: 大量排膿があれば接触予防。

records.name: Vaccinia (adverse events)
records.nameJa: ワクシニア有害事象（二次細菌感染）
records.comments: Follow organism-specific (strep, staph most frequent) recommendations and consider magnitude of drainage.
records.commentsJa: 起因菌別（溶連菌・ブドウ球菌が多い）の推奨に従い、排膿量を考慮。

records.name: Varicella Zoster
records.durationJa: 全病変が乾燥・被殻化するまで
records.comments: Susceptible HCWs should not enter room if immune caregivers available. In immunocompromised host with varicella pneumonia, prolong precautions for duration of illness. Postexposure vaccine within 120h; VZIG within 10 days if vaccine contraindicated. Exclude exposed susceptible HCWs day 8-21 after exposure.
records.commentsJa: 免疫のある医療者がいれば感受性者は入室しない。曝露後120時間以内にワクチン、ワクチン禁忌ならVZIGを10日以内。

records.commentsJa: ラッサ・マールブルグ・エボラ・クリミアコンゴ・南米出血熱。臨床安定と確定/不安定でCDCのPPE指針が異なる。期間は保健当局と個別協議。
